protocol.judge_prompt: candidate-isolated v4 score-only Korean feedback-quality rubric; source-score blind; five prompt emphases with ten seed repeats; strict vLLM json_schema; no semantic abstention

axis_feedback_quality_rubric.content: Evaluate whether the feedback accurately diagnoses idea relevance, adequacy, specificity, or development from the essay; uses support appropriately; and gives an actionable content-improvement step.
axis_feedback_quality_rubric.organization: Evaluate whether the feedback accurately diagnoses structure, sequence, paragraph linkage, coherence, or cohesion from the essay; uses support appropriately; and gives an actionable organization-improvement step.
axis_feedback_quality_rubric.expression: Evaluate whether the feedback accurately diagnoses clarity, wording, grammar, sentence construction, or style from the essay; uses support appropriately; and gives an actionable expression-improvement step.

prompt_types.review_emphasis: Apply all stated quality criteria evenly. Use the full 1-to-5 scale; do not infer an external writing label.
Give special weight to whether the diagnosis and cited sentences genuinely support each other; unsupported claims must receive a low score, not no score.
Penalize diagnoses that overclaim, are vague, or misread the essay. Calibrate severity to what the text actually supports.
Give special weight to whether each next step is concrete, feasible, and follows from its diagnosis; weak advice must receive a low score.
Give special weight to clear, internally consistent, natural Korean and a logical diagnosis-to-next-step flow; unclear communication must receive a low score.

protocol.train_scoring: score observations only; may not use validation observations
protocol.validation_scoring: frozen evaluation-only; may not influence train selection, prompt choice, SFT, DPO, or GRPO
